text:
sarah: Heads-up: published a small community-focused release  redwood-committers v0.0.1. It's a lightweight CONTRIBUTOR utility and a short maintainer guide to help community contributors onboard faster. Link + tiny install below. Also scheduling a 'Maintainers Handoff' open office hour Tue 10am PT to walk through the guide and accept new maintainer nominations.

release-bot: Release: redwood-inference/redwood-committers v0.0.1
https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-committers/releases/tag/v0.0.1
Changelog: add contributor helper CLI, MAINTAINER_GUIDE.md, sample CODE_OF_CONDUCT, tiny onboarding checklist.

sarah: Install the helper CLI (dev-friendly):
```bash
npm i -g @redwood-inference/committers-cli
# then run: committers-cli init
```

ben: License? keeping it permissive?

sarah: MIT for the CLI; repo includes a short note about attributions.

claire: Can we add a short security note about not committing API keys? I can PR a CI check for that.

sarah: Yes please @claire  adding a SECURITY.md would be great. If you open the PR, we'll fast-track it.

devrel-bot: Handoff office hour RSVP: https://forms.gle/example-handoff (pick a time slot if you want live review)

ben: For the community newsletter: two-line blurb please.

sarah: "redwood-committers v0.0.1  a tiny CLI + maintainer guide to speed community onboarding. Join our Maintainers Handoff Tue 10am PT for live reviews and nominations."

claire: I'll help run the office hour and review newcomer PRs.

sarah: Awesome  thanks! If anyone wants to nominate a community maintainer, open an issue and tag @sarah. :sparkles:
